main.description: Starts a WebAuthn assertion ceremony for signing in. Takes no authentication: this is how a session begins. The server holds the challenge against `requestId` until the ceremony finishes or expires.

identifier.description: The handle or DID signing in. Required by implementations that look the account up before offering a challenge; ignored by those that accept a discoverable credential. A client should send it whenever it knows it, which it does here because it had to resolve the handle to reach this server at all.

requestId.description: Opaque handle for this ceremony, returned to finishPasskeyLogin.

publicKey.description: PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions as WebAuthn JSON, for navigator.credentials.get().
